An '''outpost''' was built by the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Northern Snowdrift Hills]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] [[Clabburn Tundra]]. It was eventually abandoned, and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Xesh Squad]] occupied the facility in their fight against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], lining the surrounding area with mines.
